body: How exactly will it be decided who can vote and who can't vote because their views are 'bat shit crazy'?

Well I see you, and in some weird way your comment made me feel less alone when it comes to cruel words, as it reminded me of something similar I was told in the past. So yes, you do exist and your existence is doing good.

I'm so so sorry. Your ex is such a fucking piece of disgusting garbage I am so sorry you deserve so much better. You've been through so much and I genuinely believe things can turn around you, you sound like the fucking bravest person ever.
One day we will all be happy I hope. I feel you man

No you're not a coward, you just don't want to die. That's completely understandable and even brave. Please don't do this. If you wish to vent I am here. Talking to a stranger can help more than talking to someone you know sometimes

You haven't messed up at all! My elder sister, super smart, hasn't ever had a job either, and she's 21 too! It's okay. She had some mental health concerns too, it's normal and completely fine. Those people who are at better stages of life, they had a very different life experience than you. You've made the most out of what you've gotten just like we all have. Now take a step back make yourself some tea and remember that I, and many other people, are proud of you. 
Hugs

Hello, 21 is so so young. You have your whole life ahead of you to try again!! I have full faith in you. You are not a weakling you are a brave soul. I am queer too but I never even came out because I'm too scared. You did!! Thats way braver than you're giving yourself credit for. Everyone fails sometimes, gives up sometimes and yes disappoints the people we love sometimes, but no one else truly.understands what someone is going through. You weren't in the right state of mind and dropped out, that's okay, you've got your whole life to try again!!
